constraints:
Use case: scientific-educational; photorealistic rehabilitation exercise demonstration.
Input images 1–3 are STRICT IDENTITY AND STYLE REFERENCES, not target exercise poses. Repose the exact SAME woman. Preserve her facial identity, apparent age, East Asian features, natural skin texture, dark brown-black ponytail, plain fitted white short-sleeve crew-neck T-shirt, dark charcoal fitted full-length athletic trousers. Preserve the same exact cool light gray-blue seamless studio background color, gentle tonal variation and soft diffused neutral studio lighting. Floor when visible continues the same gray-blue color. Photographic realism matching references; no illustration, CGI, cosmetic face replacement or different woman.
Normal adult anatomy and realistic proportions throughout: naturally sized head, torso, shoulders, arms, hands, thighs and shins, exactly two arms and two legs, anatomically correct fingers; no stretched body, no oversized head or tiny limbs. Natural perspective like a 70mm studio lens, no wide-angle distortion. Calm relaxed expression.
ONE independent portrait 4:5 photo (match reference 1122×1402 framing), one woman, ONE exercise phase. No collage, inset, duplicate person, ghosted movement, arrows, labels, numbers, visible text, logos or watermark. Keep reference clothing and background unchanged. Use only props specifically required below, understated neutral gray. White unbranded low-profile athletic shoes for walking/standing; white plain socks without shoes for mat/kneeling; no footwear branding. Keep normal body proportions and clear exercise contact points. Do not change background to white, warm, green, gym or home interior.

actions.name: 仰卧/坐位髋内收轻夹垫
actions.phase_zh: 坐稳双脚落地，柔软枕垫置于双膝内侧轻夹。
actions.pose: T-LOW-028 Gentle seated hip-adduction pillow squeeze, choose SEATED variant. Entire body seated on a stable simple neutral gray armless chair, front three-quarter view. Upright relaxed torso, hips and knees about 90 degrees, both white shoes flat on floor. A modest soft light-gray rectangular pillow clearly held BETWEEN THE INNER SIDES OF BOTH KNEES / distal thighs, gently compressed, not placed on lap or under feet. Knees comfortably close, toes natural, no extreme leg twisting. Both hands rest lightly on upper thighs away from pillow. Face relaxed, normal breathing. Complete head, both hands, pillow, knees and feet visible with margins. One independent pose, no text or force graphics.

Side view with slight elevated obliqueness to separate both legs, head image left, feet image right. Woman lies on RIGHT side on thin gray mat with head/neck supported comfortably by small low gray pillow. actions.pose: T-LOW-030 SHORT-LEVER ASSISTED COPENHAGEN ADDUCTION SUPPORT. Educational photo from directly facing woman's chest in a side-support pose, entire person, bench and contact points framed. Head image left, legs toward image right. She supports on her LOWER RIGHT FOREARM on a thin gray floor mat, right elbow directly below right shoulder, forearm in front and palm flat.
